description: For the always-false relation, bounded search returns the bound, including bound zero, while unbounded search is undefined.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.PartialRecursiveFunctions.always_false_search (b : ℕ) :
  Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PartialRecursiveFunctions.boundedPredicateSearch (fun x => False) List.Vector.nil b =
      b ∧
    Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PartialRecursiveFunctions.predicateSearch (fun x => False) List.Vector.nil =
      Part.none
